notes: DeepFlux 7.7 - the multiview grid now plays as many IPTV streams as your provider allows: assign a channel to every tile in any layout. This release also lands a full-codebase stability and security audit: local-AI model switching no longer deadlocks, downloads no longer stall at low bandwidth limits, hostile web pages can no longer freeze the app, IPTV playlist and guide downloads are size-capped, and the Linux Jackett setup verifies its download against a pinned checksum.
